description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hakarkumbuwa, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 5103027 (23/0019)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of land ownership for specific parcels (13:1, 13:2, 13:3) in Hakurkumbura village. It includes detailed land particulars such as parcel numbers, extent, owner names, identity card numbers, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, focusing on land registrations and property ownership determinations rather than government personnel or structural changes.
